containers.name: upload
command:
set -euo pipefail
EP=http://s3.openshift-storage.svc
for f in /backup/*; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  aws --endpoint-url $EP s3 cp "$f" "s3://$BUCKET_NAME/$PREFIX/$(basename $f)"
done
KEYS=$(aws --endpoint-url $EP s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$BUCKET_NAME" --prefix "$PREFIX/" --query "sort_by(Contents,&LastModified)[].Key" --output text 2>/dev/null || true)
N=$(echo "$KEYS" | tr "\t" "\n" | grep -c . || true)
if [ "$N" -gt 30 ]; then
  echo "$KEYS" | tr "\t" "\n" | head -n -30 | while read -r k; do
    [ -n "$k" ] && aws --endpoint-url $EP s3 rm "s3://$BUCKET_NAME/$k"
  done
fi
echo "UPLOAD_OK $PREFIX ($N objets avant prune)"

initContainers.name: dump
command:
set -euo pipefail
STAMP=$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
pg_dumpall -h $PGHOST -p 5432 -U "$PGUSER" | gzip > /backup/$PGHOST-$STAMP.sql.gz
ls -lh /backup/
